scope: Review of preliminary rule-of-thumb cooling and supply-airflow only

retained_original_issue.description: Canvas lecture verifies office189W/m2 and approximateSHF0.9; chart density1.20kg/m3 adopted. Specific heat and 24/12C remain explicit trial assumptions; actual room sensible load and ADPI applicability are not established.

sources.quote: 1. Space air diffusion design for maximum load condition

• Calculate the cooling load of the open plan office using rule of thumb. 
• Determine the total supply air flow rate of the office. 
• Distribute supply air diffusers on the layout plan. 
• Calculate the supply air flow rate of each diffuser. 
• Find out the characteristic room length, L. 
• Refer to the performance data of KRUEGER “Louvered Face Diffusers 1400, 51400 
Series 4-cone”, and select a suitable type of diffuser. 
• From the diffuser performance data, find the corresponding T0.25. 
• Calculate T0.25 / L. 
• Check if it meets the ASHRAE ADPI requirement.

resolution: The brief explicitly requests a rule-of-thumb cooling calculation. Adopt the already stated 12 K temperature difference and 1006 J/(kg K) heat capacity as declared design assumptions for this preliminary coursework scenario. Lack of a detailed measured room load does not prevent this scoped calculation. ADPI room-load and physical applicability remain unresolved separately.
observations: Brief p1 explicitly requests rule-of-thumb cooling and total supply airflow;no numerical project temperatures or heat capacity are specified.
Original layout p1 labels open-plan office area1022m2. This given load area is retained;independent drawing scale and interpreted net-area difference remain unresolved for geometry.
Course lecture p1 states office189W/m2,approximately0.9 sensible heat factor and the sensible air-balance equation.
Lecture p9 gives1.20kg/m3 for its duct friction chart;the same density is explicitly adopted as a constant-property preliminary scenario,not measured room air.
12K temperature difference,represented as24/12C in the existing study,and1006J/(kgK) are selected study assumptions;they are not asserted as supplied project temperatures or measured properties.
Single-line coursework scope does not by itself require full finite fitting or whole-fan-pressure design. Those capabilities remain in the agent development goal and are not accepted here.
engineering_limits: Detailed room sensible load and ADPI load-band/category/characteristic-length applicability remain unverified.
Terminal geometry,product selection,installed routing,fire requirements and final drawing/report acceptance remain pending.
Thermal cooling kW is not motor electrical input or kVA.
